data: Is the CER performance of the bidirectional model consistently lower than the CER performance of the forward model with LA-conv?

The question asks whether the CER performance of the bidirectional model is consistently lower than the CER performance of the forward model with LA-conv across different look-ahead timesteps. 

From the left graph (a), we can observe the following:

1. The green line represents the bidirectional model, and the red dashed line represents the forward model with LA-conv.
2. The CER values for both models decrease as the look-ahead timesteps increase.
3. The green line (bidirectional model) is consistently below the red dashed line (forward model with LA-conv) throughout the range of look-ahead timesteps.

Therefore, based on the visual evidence from the left graph, the CER performance of the bidirectional model is indeed consistently lower than the CER performance of the forward model with LA-conv.
